name: mastercard-developers-mcp
description: Connect your AI assistant to Mastercard's developer platform. This server gives AI agents live access to Mastercard's full API catalog, including endpoint specs, request and response details, authentication guides for OAuth 1.0a, OAuth 2.0, and Open Finance, and structured documentation with code samples. Agents can discover services, retrieve integration guides, and generate accurate code without relying on stale training data.

_published_faq.name: How do I add mastercard-developers-mcp to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add mastercard-developers-mcp to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://developer.mcp.mastercard.com/.

_published_faq.name: Is mastercard-developers-mcp MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 6, 2026, mastercard-developers-mcp scores 100/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: How clear is mastercard-developers-mcp's MCP tool documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 6, 2026, mastercard-developers-mcp scores 80/100 in Manufact's review of tool titles, descriptions, input and output schemas, and behavior annotations. The review covers 9 of 9 discovered tools. The quality score measures documentation clarity; runtime behavior and marketplace readiness require separate checks.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the mastercard-developers-mcp MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: mastercard-developers-mcp provides these MCP tools: get-services-list, get-documentation, get-documentation-section-content, get-documentation-page, get-api-operation-list, get-api-operation-details, get-oauth10a-integration-guide, get-oauth20-integration-guide, and get-openfinance-integration-guide.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to mastercard-developers-mcp?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to mastercard-developers-mcp in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
mastercard-developers-mcp does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
